jobs.occupation: Contract Specialist - FSP - Germany (m/f/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
Job available in 2 locations: Remote, Munich

Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions
Office

Job Description

Join Us as a Site Contract Specialist – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our team , you’ll have the opportunity to prepare and negotiate contracts, as well as finalize the contract process. As a Site Contract Specialist, you'll liaise and establish effective relationships with sites and internal functional teams. You will ensure quality, objectivity, and risk analysis in the efficient delivery of contracts.

What You’ll Do:
• Drafts, reviews, negotiates and finalizes agreements with study sites in accordance with local/accepted process.
• Negotiates within approved parameters both investigator grant budget negotiation parameters, contractual terms and conditions in accordance with company contractual considerations, client contractual considerations, established process with sites and follows established escalation routes.
• Ensures compliance to established negotiation parameters, authority approval, contractual process and client expectations.
• Ensures compliance of budgetary guidance, templates and process.
• Identifies and assesses legal, financial and operational risks and escalates to appropriate level of the organization per established processes.
• Provides recommendations and alternative resolutions to Investigator Contracts negotiations through established escalation channels.
• Coordinates with internal functional departments to ensure various site startup activities are aligned with contractual activities and mutually agreed upon timelines; ensures alignment of contract negotiation process for sites and study are properly aligned to the critical path for site activation.
• Achieve target cycle times for site activations.
• Ensures guidelines and processes are followed for efficient escalation of out of parameter issues as appropriate.

Education and Experience Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
• Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2-5 years).
In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Good understanding of the principles of contract law, including a general understanding of laws that influence contract language, such as business, intellectual property and local tax and stamp laws
• Demonstrated ability to apply basic principles of investigator grant negotiation
• General understanding of business and financial principles that related to service agreements
• Effective communication skills (verbal & written) in English and local language
• Capable, with appropriate oversight, of drafting and negotiating contract provisions and budgetary issues within parameters
• Demonstrated ability in attention to detail
• Excellent analytical and decision based thinking skills
• Understanding of the pharmaceutical product development process and involvement of CROs
• Able to work independently or in a team environment
• Good organizational and time management skills
• Working knowledge of PPD SOP & WPDs
• Able to organize competing priorities logically and review outstanding contractual risk and issues
• Able to effectively use automated systems and computerized applications
• Ability to demonstrate a customer focused style of communication, problem solving and collaboration

Working Conditions and Environment:
• Ability to work in an upright and /or stationary position for 6-8 hours per day.
• Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
• Frequent mobility required.
• Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
• Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
• Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
• Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
• Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups.
• Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence. Ability to perform under stress. Ability to multi-task.
• Regular and consistent attendance.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a visionary Product and Solution Security Officer (PSSO) to champion our PSS program within Siemens SI GSW. As a key driver of our continuous quality culture, you will ensure that cybersecurity is deeply integrated into our software development lifecycle.
Acting as a 'Continuous Security Agent,' you will partner with the Agile Program Management Office (APMO) to bring state-of-the-art security innovations to our agile teams. You will build vibrant communities and guilds to promote a culture of continuous learning. As a trusted advisor, you will guide R&D and PLM leadership, collaborating closely with the SI GSW Cybersecurity Officer to provide functional guidance to our network of PSSEs.
What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- Appealing Siemens pension benefits- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by

(Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP or CSSLP are an advantage).- Experience & Skills: - Extensive long-term experience and demonstrated expertise in cybersecurity, software development, and engineering, including in-depth knowledge of IT/Cybersecurity requirements.- Deep knowledge of IEC 62443, ISO 27000, and related standards, with years of experience in IT/Cybersecurity for product development, solution design, and OT operations.- Proven track record in implementing regulatory requirements within agile environments.- Experience in managing or supporting the release of large-scale software projects, with a strong proficiency in conducting risk assessments and implementing subsequent risk management strategies.- Active commitment to knowledge sharing, including the initiation of "Communities of Practice" and the creation of technical blueprints, templates, and building blocks.- Strong proficiency in agile development and DevOps principles, including a solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and container technologies.- Practical experience with agile scaling frameworks such as LeSS or SAFe.- Experience working in international, multicultural agile organizations with a high degree of quality awareness.- Ability to structure and guide new security-related processes and regulations across the entire organization.
- Ways of working: - Analytical thinking, strong problem-solving skills, and reliability, even in complex situations.- Proven ability to collaborate efficiently across functional and project boundaries, with the skill to effectively communicate complex content and risks to stakeholders at all organizational levels, including senior management.- A proactive mindset and the willingness to go the extra mile as part of our ambitious and multicultural SI GSW team.
- Languages**:** Professional proficiency in English is required; German language skills are an advantage.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

jobs.occupation: Business Development and Key Account Manager (all genders) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEAt ERC, we are developing hybrid-electric VTOL aircraft for critical missions across uncrewed and crewed applications. Victor is our uncrewed heavy-lift cargo UAS for time-critical cargo, logistics, military resupply, and other critical dual-use missions. Charlie is our future crewed aircraft for passenger and patient transport, including air ambulance and interhospital transport.
In this role, you will identify and develop commercial opportunities and build long-term customer and partner relationships. Working closely with Commercial Leadership, Product, Engineering, and Flight Operations, you will turn customer needs into account strategies, go-to-market projects, partnership models, and concrete customer programs.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Identify, qualify, and strategically develop commercial opportunities across our priority customer segments, use cases, and target accounts
• Own selected key accounts from initial engagement through structured needs assessment, opportunity development, implementation projects, proposal generation, and long-term growth
• Drive customer and partner initiatives such as workshops, customer demonstrations, operational validation projects, and joint entry-into-service projects
• Coordinate externally facing projects across internal teams, keeping timelines, responsibilities, decisions, and stakeholder expectations under control
• Support the refinement of ERC’s commercial strategy by contributing customer and opportunity insights, market research, and competitor analysis
• Help translate customer and operator needs into mission concepts, product requirements, demonstration objectives, and commercially viable solutions in collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Flight Operations
• Support the planning and execution of product demonstrations, trade fairs, and industry events; and represent ERC in customer meetings, demonstrations, trade fairs, and industry events.

WHAT YOU BRING
• Approximately 2-3 years of experience in business development, key account management, sales, management consulting, or a comparable high-pace, high-performance environment
• Proven experience building sustainable relationships with customers, partners, or other external stakeholders in complex industry environments
• Strong project management skills and the ability to drive cross-functional workstreams with clear structure, ownership, and follow-through
• Strong analytical and commercial judgment, including the ability to prioritize customer needs and business opportunities
• Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills
• A structured, self-directed, and ownership-oriented working style in an entrepreneurial environment
• Fluency in English and willingness to travel.

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• have first experience in industries such as logistics, infrastructure, offshore operations, aviation operations, or adjacent markets
• bring aviation experience or strong technical curiosity for aircraft, UAS, eVTOL, autonomous systems, or complex tech products
• are familiar with military procurement processes, bring an active military network, or have formerly served in the armed forces
• speak German at C1 level or above.

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

jobs.occupation: Social Media Manager  (d/f/m) (Social-Media-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Airbus Defence and Space we are looking for a

Social Media Manager (d/f/m)

A vacancy for a Digital Communications Manager (d/f/m) has arisen within Airbus in Taufkirchen/München. The successful applicant will join the team of External Communications within Airbus Defence and Space.

Job Profile and Department description
The job holder is part of a team which is responsible to define priorities and implement communications plans for external audiences by animating the Company's corporate external channels (media, web, social media).

The External Communications department engages with external audiences by adapting content to external channels’ (media relations, web, social) requirements, defines and implements the group’s external communications strategy, orchestrates external media relations and provides audience- and business-related performance indicators to the divisions for continuous content planning and improvement. It contributes to the promotion and protection of the Airbus brand and to the external positioning of its products, services, people and top management.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. You are into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Our benefits for you

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Contribute to digital communications editorial content with the focus on all relevant divisional defence, space and security topics
- Participate to enhancing visibility and impact of Airbus communications and contents via digital channels (mainly social media)
- Support Social Media positioning of the Airbus Defence and Space CEO as well as other divisional top management members
- Ability to manage production (e.g. content/photo/video/infographics) and publish on any defined channel (internal and external)
- Build and implement new proposals based on trends
- Manage internal and external stakeholders, including agencies, subcontractors and transversal remote teams
- Promote better branded storytelling and ensure consistent editorial voice
- Develop and implement dedicated content for special campaigns on social media
- Manage social media campaigns in close cooperation with the Communications Business Partners
- Manages the related social media channels
- Working closely with the Programme Lines (all, but with a particular focus on digital transformation, unmanned aerial systems or security topics) and the responsible Communications Business Partners.
- Build-up and management of creator relationships across our home nations
- This role will involve frequent travel for business (under non-pandemic conditions) and as such you should be willing to travel.

Desired skills and qualifications

- You are educated to a degree level in Communications, (Digital) Marketing, Business Administration or equivalent
- You have a background in digital communications and marketing as well as a proven track-record in managing and working with social media tools and channels (HootSuite, TalkWalker, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube)
- You already gained some experience in audience insights (research, target audience definition, end user experience analysis, customer journeys) and creator management
- You are used to working with benchmarks and watches for trends and best practice to identify valuable opportunities
- You have (profound) knowledge of digital strategy and related topics
- You are able to create content for different communication channels (not limited to social media but expertise in web management would also be appreciated)
- You are a proficient user of digital tools and platforms
- Your workstyle is characterized by your positive, energetic, adaptable and multi-tasking attitude and your out of the box thinking
- You are a strong team player, engaged and like to work in collaborative and international environment
- You have good communication skills and know how to communicate towards different stakeholders and across all levels of hierarchy
- You speak German and English on negotiation level and it is a plus, if you speak French and/or Spanish as well

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Electrical Designer for Power Transformers (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join our global team as a highly skilled Electrical Designer for Power Transformers (f/m/d), acting as a central hub of expertise and support for Power Transformer and Shunt Reactors engineers in our factories worldwide. Your role is crucial for ensuring our design processes are efficient, reliable, and continuously evolving. You will focus on providing support in applying solutions and guiding engineers, working closely with factories in Brazil, Mexico, and the USA to implement new tools, design rules, and innovative solutions. By connecting factory needs with our R&D development team, you will help shape the next generation of design technology and foster a culture of continuous learning.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Provide quick technical support to product engineers and assist transformer engineers with R&D rules and tools to minimize downtime
* Conduct pre-release tests of tools in real-world scenarios and provide feedback to developers
* Improve information flow and facilitate communication between factories, R&D, and other stakeholders, ensuring alignment with factory needs
* Ensure consistent global quality through structured technology transfer and work on a centralized knowledge hub for engineers
* Cultivate a community for experts to share knowledge and develop training programs for widespread adoption of best practices
* Propose improvements for tools and rules based on factory experiences, linking R&D advancements with practical engineering applications

What You Bring

* A completed degree in Electrical Engineering
* Longterm experience in Large Power Transformers and Shunt Reactors Design
* Strong understanding of various transformer and reactor types, including electrical design and calculations for dielectric, electro-magnetic, heating, cooling, and noise
* Good understanding of transformer components and their interactions, such as the core, windings, insulation, and leads
* A solid understanding of engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and quality processes, along with experience in technical product development
* Proficiency in English

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

With a legacy of innovation since 1899, a presence in more than 30 countries, and more than 19,000 employees, we are advancing breakthrough therapies in oncology, cardiovascular disease, rare diseases, and immune disorders. Guided by our 2030 vision to "be an innovative global healthcare company contributing to the sustainable development of society", we are shaping a healthier, more hopeful future for patients, their families, and society.

Manager (m/w/d) Formulation Technology - Biologics

The "Manager Formulation Technology - Biologics" is responsible for the planning, organization and technical support of development activities in Formulation Technology for Parenteral Formulation and Process Development (e.g. lyophilization) incl. physicochemical characterization of Biologics (focus on oncology, e.g. ADCs). Development, optimization and upscaling of GMP-compatible manufacturing processes for lyophilization of biologics (e.g. Anti-body drug conjugates, ADCs), incl. preparation and documentation of development activities
Creation of risk analyses and statistical design of experiments (DoE) within the framework of formulation and process development of biologics

Functional and technical management of contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs) for clinical trials material manufacturing, as well as technology transfers to in-house manufacturing sites and CMOs in Europe, incl. on-site support
Supporting the team in creating and reviewing manufacturing protocols and reports
Support the preparation of regulatory submission documents; incl. NDA, and BLA.
Collaboration with various international multidisciplinary project teams (incl. colleagues from Japan, US and CMOs in Europe)

University degree in Pharmacy or related subject, ideally with PhD in Pharmaceutical Technology (focus on Lyophilization and Biologics)
At least two years of relevant work experience in pharmaceutical industry (formulation and process development).
Previous experiences with CMO management, global CMC development, technology transfer and handling of high potent Biologics are preferrable.
Experience in Design of Experiments and upscaling of GMP-compatible manufacturing processes (Fill and Finish)
Previous expertise in CMC regulatory requirements and submissions
Very good written and oral communication skills in English and German
Very good IT skills (MS Office, SAP etc.)
Willingness to travel on business trips, if needed

jobs.occupation: Flight Test Engineer (all genders) (Testingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEJoin ERC’s flight test team and contribute to the development and certification of next-generation unmanned aircraft systems. As a Flight Test Engineer, you will contribute directly to the development and certification of our uncrewed heavy-lift VTOL platform. You will be responsible for the planning, execution, and evaluation of ground and flight tests, ensuring safe and compliant operations while generating the data needed to advance our aircraft toward certification.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Plan, prepare, and coordinate aircraft ground and flight test campaigns for development and certification activities
• Act as focal point for test requests from engineering departments and translate them into structured ground and flight test plans
• Categorize test requests and define test objectives, test conditions, and instrumentation requirements in collaboration with relevant stakeholders
• Support the planning, installation, and documentation of flight test instrumentation
• Conduct pre-flight inspections and regular maintenance activities
• Support engineering teams in the manufacturing, integration, test aircraft
• Support weight and balance calculations and measurement activities
• Participate as remote crew member in ground and flight tests by managing and monitoring test sequence execution using telemetry systems from the ground station
• Conduct pre-test briefings and post-test debriefings
• Initiate, coordinate, and track actions to resolve deficiencies and implement recommendations identified during debriefings and in test reports
• Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation, including Flight Test Cards and Flight Test Reports
• Support the continuous development of our Flight Test Organization by improving tools, processes, and methodologies

WHAT YOU BRING
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace engineering or a comparable discipline
• Professional experience in flight test operations incl. test planning, execution, and data analysis with manned aircraft and/or rotorcraft, or professional experience in the operation of drones and/or model aircraft
• Solid understanding of aircraft systems, flight mechanics, and flight test methodologies
• Hands-on mindset with the ability to work effectively in a dynamic flight test environment
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
• Ability to coordinate across multiple engineering disciplines
• Flexibility and willingness to travel and stay at national and international flight test locations for short- and mid-term campaigns
• Very good verbal and written communication skills in English and German

Nice to have:
• Experience with eVTOL or unmanned aircraft systems
• Knowledge of EASA certification frameworks (e.g., SC-VTOL, SORA)
• Experience with telemetry systems and flight test instrumentation
• Familiarity with data analysis tools (e.g., Python, MATLAB)

WHAT WEC OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

jobs.occupation: Working student (d/f/m) in the area of Flight Dynamics (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Flight Dynamics department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working student (d/f/m) in the area of Flight Dynamics

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Flight Dynamics Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Flight Dynamics department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: Dezember 2026
- Duration: 12 months

The Flight Dynamics team in Manching develops in-house advanced software tools aimed at large data analysis and post processing. In this context, verification and validation of these tools is required to ensure compliance to the specific tools process.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Checking the scope and code of the tool and the already existing tests as a baseline for discussion and required depth of test coverage.
- Checking the requirements defined as Jira tickets of the tool and discuss potential unclear formulations as well as the scope of testing.
- Choosing requirements to test within a one-week time horizon.
- Implementing test cases within the defined scope (i.e., automatized, repeated, checking edge conditions, checking correct and incorrect user handling,...).
- Incorporating the test cases in the continuous integration pipeline, executing it, and checking the results.
- Documenting the outcome of the tests (i.e., results, limitation, bugs, potential improvements) within the tool’s documentation and reviewing the implemented test cases, discussion of improvements, and providing deliverables on a weekly basis.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full time student (d/f/m) within computer science, data science, informatics or related disciplines.
- Extensive experience in at least one of the following programming languages:
- Java 1.8 and JUnit4 or JUnit5
- Matlab R2024b and testsuite
- Python 3.12 and pytest
- Extensive experience in continuous integration pipeline setup in Jenkins.
- Extensive experience in working with git, specifically Bitbucket as well as knowledge in working with Atlassian toolset, like Confluence and Jira.
- Knowledge of SLURM workload manager
- Knowledge of Linux, Microsoft Word and Latex to report results.
- Understanding of Flight Dynamics (e.g., nonlinear simulation) is a plus.
- Understanding of database structures (e.g., sqlite) and large data storages (e.g., HDF5 or parquet) is a plus.
- Self-organized, team-oriented way of working.
- Advanced English, German is a plus.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

jobs.occupation: RDT Business Partner (m/w/d) RDT Pharma International (Informationsmanager/in)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Let’s build a healthier future, together. In the role of RDT Business Partner at Roche Digital Technology (RDT) / Informatics, you will make a decisive contribution to turning our vision "Doing now what patients need next" into reality. You are part of RDT Pharma International and belong to the RDT Business Partner team at the preferred location in Grenzach. Here, we combine technological innovation with commercial goals to continuously improve patient care through digital solutions and actively shape the healthcare ecosystem.

Responsibilities | What awaits you

In this role, you will take responsibility for the strategic connection between Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and the assigned business functions to advance Roche's strategic goals through groundbreaking technology solutions. In addition, you will take on the following exciting tasks:
* Stakeholder Management: You act as a trusted strategic partner and advisor to business leaders, co-create technology-enabled strategies, and proactively drive global process improvements.
* Bridge between Local & Global: You bundle the local requirements of the business functions (Commercial, Finance, P&C, Supply Chain, etc.), advocate for local needs at the global level when necessary, and conversely bring global standard solutions effectively to Germany.
* Innovation & Impact: You specifically identify business opportunities and work closely with Product Leads to design, prototype, and continuously develop innovative technological capabilities.
* Complexity Management: You are accountable for the successful delivery of technology-enabled business outcomes (such as annual revenue goals or patient access) for commercial areas.
* Problem Solving: In strong partnership with Product Engineering Teams, you are responsible for the escalation and targeted resolution of complex, systemic challenges.
* Technology Focus: As a Key Opinion Leader, you drive the technological vision forward, manage stakeholders end-to-end, and scale pilot solutions to maximize their added value.

Qualifications | Who you are

For this demanding interface role, you bring sound IT knowledge, strong business acumen, and excellent communication skills:
* Education: Successfully completed Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master’s degree or MBA is a plus.
* Professional Experience & Industry Knowledge: Sound experience participating in IT projects within complex matrix organizations as well as strong business acumen in the pharmaceutical / life sciences environment.
* Partnership & Moderation: Proven track record of building trusted relationships across different organizational levels (including management level), as well as strong competence in conflict management and moderating complex interfaces.
* Language & Communication Skills: You bring excellent communication skills (fluent/negotiating-level English for collaboration in a global environment as well as very good German skills for daily interaction at the Grenzach site).
* Working Style & Presence: High flexibility, strong analytical skills, and systems thinking, as well as the willingness for on-site presence at the Grenzach location.
* Teamwork: Strong ability to collaborate constructively in cross-functional, agile teams and to actively promote appreciative cooperation.

Duration: This position is a temporary assignment limited until January 2028.

Your Application

We ask you for a current CV and your official (educational) certificates/proofs. 

Further documents are currently not mandatory. Please note before submitting the application that no further documents can be added afterwards. 

Apply now – we look forward to meeting you!

 

 

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Do you need further support?

Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Technology Scouting & Innovation Manager (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Grid Technologies. Your typical day will involve systematically identifying emerging technologies, monitoring market disruptions, and analyzing startup activities. You will serve as the organization’s “early warning and opportunity detection system,” translating external technology signals into actionable insights that inform strategy, portfolio steering, and investment decisions.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and maintain a structured technology scouting process across H1–H4 horizons
* Identify emerging technologies with potential impact on Grid Technologies
* Own and continuously update the PRM Technology Radar and create strategic heatmaps of technology opportunities and threats
* Maintain visibility of startup, university, and research ecosystems to support partnership and investment opportunities
* Establish and maintain a central technology knowledge repository to ensure effective dissemination of insights
* Produce actionable intelligence reports for leadership teams and convert technology signals into portfolio recommendations

What You Bring

* Relevant and applicable bachelor’s degree/diploma
* Long-term experience in technology development and Ventures/M&A type projects
* Strong technical focus with a solid understanding of what Siemens Energy does, though not necessarily an expert in specific technologies
* Experience in innovation projects involving universities, research facilities, or similar environments
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills in global matrix organizations, with the ability to translate external signals into clear portfolio and roadmap insights
* Fluent in English

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

jobs.occupation: PhD Student for the Hector-Center, Medical Clinic 1, (m/f/d) (Assistent/in - klinische Studien)
jobs.description:
The Hector-Center for Nutrition, Exercise and Sports, Medical Clinic 1, conducts clinical and experimental research in the fields of cancer, obesity, food intolerances, and microbiota. Our translational research projects aim to better understand disease mechanisms and ultimately improve patient care and therapeutic strategies.
A major focus of our research is cancer cachexia, a complex metabolic syndrome that significantly contributes to loss of skeletal muscle and adipose tissue, impaired physical function, reduced quality of life, and poor clinical outcomes in patients with cancer.
Within this research area, we investigate the interactions between cancer cells, skeletal muscle, adipose tissue, and immune cells, with a particular focus on the molecular and immunological mechanisms underlying cancer-associated tissue wasting.

Die Aufgaben

To strengthen our research team, we are looking for an excellent and highly motivated PhD student with a strong interest in cancer biology, metabolism, immunology, and/or molecular medicine.
Depending on the specific research focus, the work will involve:

- in vitro studies with cancer and muscle cells as well as immune cell models and analysis of tissue samples
- contribution to in vivo studies with mice
- preparation of scientific manuscripts and the PhD thesis

Das Know-how dafür

- Master’s degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Medicine, Biotechnology, or a related field
- solid knowledge of cellular and molecular biology
- practical experience with cell culture and molecular biology techniques
- ability to work independently, systematically, and reliably
- strong scientific curiosity and willingness to develop new experimental approaches
- ability to analyze and critically interpret scientific data
- excellent communication and teamwork skills
- good written and spoken English

Zusätzlich von Vorteil

- experience with cancer, skeletal muscle, adipocyte, or immune cell models
- experience with molecular biology techniques such as qPCR, Western blotting, immunofluorescence, or flow cytometry
- FELASA B certificate is advantageous but not mandatory

We are looking for a motivated scientist who is enthusiastic about understanding the mechanisms of cancer-associated wasting and developing new approaches to preserve tissue function and improve outcomes in patients with cancer.

Das bieten wir:

- salary according to E13 TV-L, 65%
- the position is intended to lead to a PhD
- an interdisciplinary and collaborative research environment
- access to modern laboratory infrastructure and established experimental models
- opportunities for scientific training, conference participation, and publication
- close supervision and support throughout the PhD project

jobs.occupation: Engineer (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Your job in the future market of lasers and photonics

Since its foundation, Menlo Systems GmbH has been one of the world market leaders in the field of optical precision measurements with light and lasers. Based on the Nobel Prize-winning frequency comb technology, we provide our customers worldwide with laser systems that enable applications with the highest precision and accuracy. The systems are mainly used in metrology and spectroscopy, in optical clocks, in quantum technology and quantum computers, as well as in materials testing and 3D printing. Our customers include leading research institutions and high-tech companies worldwide.

To strengthen our team at our main location in Planegg-Martinsried near Munich, we are now looking for a

FPGA / Mixed-Signal Design Engineer (m/f/d)

Development of FPGA/SoC-based digital designs for the control and readout of complex, robust laser systems

Ownership of the full FPGA/SoC development lifecycle: from requirements definition and system architecture through RTL implementation, simulation and prototyping to a qualified product

Definition of the digital system architecture in close crossfunctional cooperation with other departments
Design and implementation of digital signal processing chains and control loops

Bring-up, verification and debugging of FPGA designs on target hardware, including measurements and performance analysis

Creation of verification plans, testbenches and test procedures, as well as development of prototypes and support of system-level verification and validation campaigns

Documentation of the design according to customer and quality requirements

Degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or a comparable qualification

2+ years of experience in FPGA/digital design with Verilog/SystemVerilog and/or VHDL

Practical experience with AMD/Xilinx Vivado, Intel Quartus or comparable toolchains, including synthesis, place-and-route and static timing analysis

Experience with SoC platforms and the interplay between Processing System (PS) and Programmable Logic (PL)
Solid understanding of digital signal processing fundamentals and experience implementing digital control loops

Experience with Python/NumPy or MATLAB/Simulink for algorithm exploration, fixed-point modelling and verification against RTL

Enjoyment of hands-on lab work combined with a high level of initiative and sense of responsibility
Very good written and spoken English, German is a plus

Exciting and challenging tasks in a dynamically growing market
Independent work in a highly motivated team with creative freedom
Remuneration that gives you a share in the company's success and a company pension scheme
Individual and practice-oriented training and opportunities for professional development
JobRad-Leasing or free Deutschlandticket
30 days' vacation and regular employee events
A secure job and a permanent position
Flat hierarchies, an informal culture and short decision-making paths

jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world's most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 51,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM has a multidisciplinary team working with Data Centre clients across both Hyperscale and Colocation and Enterprise projects across Western Europe.

This job opening focusses on the German Market, seeking someone with a strong Design Management background in the local DC sector.

This will require deep engagement to materialize and to ensure and timely delivery, meeting the recurring clients’ deadlines, budget and requirements.

The design manager identifies the right level and capability of resources to be deployed on the project. It is the design managers responsibility to ensure the right level of bidding and pricing of new opportunities ensuring they are delivered as sold fees and margins. Thus, implying Project Management capabilities.

**Job Responsibilities:** 

- Design Management in a high paced project environment in the German market
- Covering multidisciplinary cross regional teams of CSA & MEP
- Assisting bids commercially and technically for multi-disciplinary opportunities with key clients
- Ensuring all internal as well as local regulatory governance is followed: both at bid stage and throughout the delivery of projects

Qualifications

- Senior Multidisciplinary Design Manager (MEP / Architectural Background)
- DC Experience in accountable DM position
- Proficient in contractual German and English
- Ability to manage a busy workload and deadlines
- Excellent communication skills are essential

Additional Information

Why join us?
You will love the freedom to bring your own ideas and vision to life, combining client management, project delivery, and team leadership. You will value working alongside colleagues with outstanding technical expertise in a collaborative, caring, and supportive team environment. We offer a flexible working environment, a competitive salary, and a culture that places safety, wellbeing, and professional development at the heart of everything we do.

If you are looking to work for one of the world’s most trusted global environmental consulting firms and help shape a more sustainable future for Germany and beyond, the AECOM Germany team looks forward to welcoming you on board.
